stem: In a double circulatory system, blood passes through the heart twice in one complete circuit of the body. The complete circuit consists of the pulmonary circulation and the systemic circulation.

parts.label: (a)
(b)
parts.text:
The alveolus is the gas exchange surface in mammals. For efficient oxygen uptake, a steep diffusion gradient is maintained between the alveolar air and the blood.

Suggest how the steep diffusion gradient for oxygen is maintained at the gas exchange surface.

parts.label: (c)
parts.stem:
Compared to when they were non-smokers, the ability of people who smoke tobacco to deliver oxygen to their body tissues is reduced. Two causes of this reduction include:

• a decrease in the volume of air per breath moving towards the alveoli
• a decrease in the ability of red blood cells to carry oxygen.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: Suggest **one** reason why smoking tobacco, even after only a short time, may cause a decrease in the volume of air per breath moving towards the alveoli.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Explain why smoking tobacco causes a decrease in the ability of red blood cells to carry oxygen.
